_readme: Starting catalog (REQ-1.10). Recipes written by the Forkful team in our own words. To add one: copy an entry, give it a unique slug, and run `npm run db:seed`. Allowed units are listed in scripts/lib/seed-validate.mjs. quantity is a number (0.5 for 1/2), or null for 'to taste'. quantity_max is only for ranges like 2-3. raw_text is optional; the script builds it if missing. Photos must be ours or freely licensed (BR-12); leave photo fields out until then.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Pasta
recipes.description: A quick weeknight pasta with garlic, butter, and parmesan.
steps: Cook the spaghetti in well-salted boiling water until al dente. Save 1/2 cup of the pasta water, then drain.
Melt the butter in a large pan over medium-low heat. Add the garlic and cook for 1 to 2 minutes until fragrant but not browned.
Add the pasta to the pan with a splash of the pasta water and toss to coat.
Stir in the parmesan and parsley, adding more pasta water if it looks dry. Season with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Classic Pancakes
recipes.description: Fluffy breakfast pancakes from pantry staples.
steps: Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
In another bowl, whisk the milk, egg, and melted butter.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ones and stir just until combined. A few lumps are fine.
Heat a lightly greased pan over medium heat. Pour about 1/4 cup of batter per pancake.
Cook until bubbles form on top, about 2 minutes, then flip and cook 1 to 2 minutes more.

recipes.title: Chicken Fried Rice
recipes.description: Leftover rice turned into a fast one-pan dinner.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon of the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat. Cook the chicken until no longer pink, about 5 minutes, then move it to a plate.
Add the rest of the oil. Pour in the eggs and scramble until just set, then push them to the side.
Add the peas and carrots and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the rice, breaking up any clumps, and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Return the chicken, add the soy sauce and sesame oil, and toss. Top with green onions.

recipes.title: Black Bean Tacos
recipes.description: Smoky black bean tacos with a quick lime slaw.
steps: Put the beans, cumin, paprika, and water in a saucepan over medium heat. Simmer for 5 minutes, mashing about half the beans.
Toss the cabbage with the lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for about 30 seconds per side.
Fill each tortilla with beans and top with the slaw.

recipes.title: Tomato Basil Soup
recipes.description: A smooth tomato soup made with canned tomatoes.
steps: Heat the olive oil in a pot over medium heat. Cook the onion for 5 minutes until soft, then add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes with their juice and the broth. Simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the basil and blend until smooth.
Stir in the cream if using, and season with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.description: Chewy cookies with crisp edges.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and line two baking sheets with parchment.
Whisk the flour, baking soda, and salt in a bowl.
Beat the butter and both sugars until fluffy. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla.
Mix in the flour mixture on low speed, then stir in the chocolate chips.
Drop rounded tablespoons of dough 2 inches apart. Bake for 9 to 11 minutes until the edges are golden.
Cool on the sheet for 5 minutes before moving to a rack.

recipes.title: Greek Salad
recipes.description: Crisp vegetables, olives, and feta with a lemon-oregano dressing.
steps: Combine the cucumber, tomatoes, onion, and olives in a large bowl.
Whisk the olive oil, lemon juice, and oregano, then pour over the salad and toss.
Top with the feta, in one piece or crumbled.

recipes.title: Beef Chili
recipes.description: A hearty one-pot chili with beans.
steps: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Brown the beef, breaking it up, then drain off extra fat.
Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes. Add the garlic, chili powder, and cumin and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomatoes, beans, and broth. Bring to a boil, then lower the heat.
Simmer uncovered for 45 minutes, stirring now and then. Season with salt.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
recipes.description: Moist banana bread for overripe bananas.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and grease a 9 by 5 inch loaf pan.
Mix the bananas and melted butter. Stir in the sugar, egg, and vanilla.
Sprinkle the baking soda and salt over the mixture and stir, then mix in the flour.
Pour into the pan and bake for 55 to 65 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a rack.

recipes.title: Chickpea Curry
recipes.description: A creamy coconut curry with chickpeas and spinach.
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat. Cook the onion for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, ginger, and curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chickpeas, coconut milk, and tomatoes. Simmer for 15 minutes until slightly thickened.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, and season with salt. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Roasted Vegetables
recipes.description: Mixed vegetables roasted until caramelized.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss all the vegetables with the olive oil, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Spread in a single layer on a large baking sheet.
Roast for 25 to 30 minutes, stirring halfway, until tender and browned at the edges.

recipes.title: Overnight Oats
recipes.description: No-cook oats you make the night before.
steps: Stir the oats, milk, yogurt, chia seeds, and honey together in a jar.
Cover and refrigerate overnight, or for at least 4 hours.
Top with berries before serving.

recipes.title: Classic Meatloaf
recipes.description: A tender beef loaf with a sweet and tangy glaze.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Stir the breadcrumbs into the milk and let them soak for 5 minutes.
Add the beef, onion, eggs, garlic, salt, and pepper. Mix gently with your hands until just combined; overmixing makes it dense.
Shape into a loaf about 9 by 5 inches on a lined baking sheet.
Stir together the ketchup, brown sugar, and vinegar, and spread half over the top.
Bake for 45 minutes, spread on the rest of the glaze, and bake 15 minutes more, until the center reaches 160°F (71°C).
Rest for 10 minutes before slicing.

recipes.title: Stovetop Mac and Cheese
recipes.description: Creamy cheddar macaroni made in one pot, no oven needed.
steps: Cook the macaroni in well-salted boiling water until just tender. Drain.
In the same pot, melt the butter over medium heat. Whisk in the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in the milk and simmer, stirring, until it thickens enough to coat a spoon, about 5 minutes.
Turn the heat to low and stir in the cheddar a handful at a time until smooth. Add the mustard powder and salt.
Stir the macaroni back in and serve right away.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Biscuits
recipes.description: Tall, flaky biscuits with crisp golden tops.
steps: Heat the oven to 450°F (230°C).
Whisk the flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Cut in the butter with your fingertips or a pastry cutter until pea-sized pieces remain.
Stir in the buttermilk just until a shaggy dough forms.
Pat the dough out to 1 inch thick, fold it in half, and pat it out again. Repeat twice for flaky layers.
Cut out rounds without twisting the cutter and place them touching on a baking sheet.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until tall and golden.

recipes.title: Skillet Cornbread
recipes.description: Lightly sweet cornbread with crunchy edges from a hot pan.

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.note: melted, plus more for the pan

steps: Put a 10-inch cast-iron skillet in the oven and heat both to 400°F (200°C).
Whisk the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
In another bowl, whisk the milk, eggs, and melted butter. Stir into the dry ingredients until just combined.
Carefully take out the hot skillet, add a little butter to coat it, and pour in the batter.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until golden and a toothpick comes out clean.

recipes.title: Sloppy Joes
recipes.description: Saucy ground beef sandwiches ready in about half an hour.
steps: Brown the beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up. Pour off most of the fat.
Add the onion and bell pepper and cook until soft, about 5 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomato sauce, ketchup, brown sugar, and mustard. Simmer for 10 minutes until thick.
Season with salt and pepper and spoon onto the buns.

recipes.title: Chicken Noodle Soup
recipes.description: A comforting soup of chicken, vegetables, and egg noodles.
steps: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Cook the onion, carrots, and celery until softened, about 6 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the broth, chicken, thyme, and bay leaf. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Lift out the chicken, shred it with two forks, and return it to the pot. Remove the bay leaf.
Add the noodles and simmer until tender, 6 to 8 minutes. Stir in the parsley and season with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Creamy Coleslaw
recipes.description: Crunchy cabbage and carrot slaw in a tangy dressing.
steps: Toss the green cabbage, red cabbage, and carrot in a large bowl.
Whisk the mayonnaise, vinegar, sugar, and celery seed. Season with salt and pepper.
Pour the dressing over the vegetables and toss well.
Chill for at least 30 minutes so the flavors blend.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp
recipes.description: Warm cinnamon apples under a buttery oat topping.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C).
Toss the apples with the sugar, cinnamon, and lemon juice, and spread in a 9 by 13-inch baking dish.
Mix the oats, flour, brown sugar, and salt. Rub in the butter until clumpy.
Scatter the topping over the apples.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes, until the top is golden and the apples bubble at the edges.

recipes.title: Blueberry Muffins
recipes.description: Soft muffins bursting with berries and a sugar-crusted top.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a 12-cup muffin tin.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
In another bowl, whisk the milk, oil, egg, and vanilla. Stir into the dry ingredients until just combined.
Fold in the blueberries gently.
Divide among the cups, sprinkle with coarse sugar, and bake for 18 to 22 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.

recipes.title: Soft Scrambled Eggs with Chives
recipes.description: Silky eggs cooked low and slow, ready in minutes.
steps: Whisk the eggs, milk, and a pinch of salt until no streaks remain.
Melt the butter in a nonstick pan over low heat.
Add the eggs and stir slowly with a spatula, scraping the bottom, until soft curds form, 4 to 6 minutes.
Take the pan off the heat while the eggs still look a little wet; they finish cooking on the plate.
Top with chives and pepper.

recipes.title: Oven Pulled Pork
recipes.description: Slow-roasted, spice-rubbed pork for sandwiches or tacos.
steps: Heat the oven to 300°F (150°C).
Mix the brown sugar, paprika, salt, garlic powder, onion powder, and pepper, and rub all over the pork.
Put the pork in a Dutch oven, pour the vinegar around it, cover, and roast for about 4 hours, until it falls apart easily.
Shred the meat with two forks, discarding any large pieces of fat.
Toss with the barbecue sauce and some of the cooking juices.

recipes.title: Classic Potato Salad
recipes.description: Creamy picnic potato salad with egg, celery, and pickles.
steps: Put the potatoes in a pot of cold salted water, bring to a boil, and simmer until just tender, about 12 minutes. Drain and cool.
Whisk the mayonnaise, mustard, and pickle juice.
Fold the potatoes, eggs, celery, and pickles into the dressing.
Season with salt and pepper, sprinkle with dill, and chill for at least 1 hour.

recipes.title: Fudgy Brownies
recipes.description: Dense chocolate brownies with a shiny, crackly top.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and line an 8-inch square pan with parchment.
Melt the butter, then whisk in the sugar until glossy. Whisk in the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla.
Stir in the cocoa, flour, and salt until just combined. Fold in the chocolate chips.
Spread in the pan and bake for 25 to 28 minutes, until the edges are set and the center is just firm.
Cool completely before cutting.

recipes.title: Chicken and Sausage Jambalaya
recipes.description: A smoky one-pot rice dish from Louisiana.
steps: Heat the oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Brown the sausage, then lift it out.
Season the chicken with half the Cajun seasoning, brown it in the same pot, and lift it out.
Cook the onion, bell pepper, and celery until soft, about 6 minutes. Add the garlic and the rest of the seasoning for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomatoes, rice, broth, sausage, and chicken. Bring to a boil.
Cover, turn the heat to low, and cook for 20 to 25 minutes without lifting the lid, until the rice is tender.
Rest for 5 minutes, fluff, and top with green onions.

recipes.title: Shrimp and Grits
recipes.description: Cheesy grits topped with garlicky shrimp and bacon.
steps: Bring the water and salt to a boil. Whisk in the grits, turn the heat to low, and simmer, stirring often, for 20 to 25 minutes until thick and creamy.
Stir the cheddar and butter into the grits and keep warm.
Cook the bacon in a skillet until crisp. Lift it out, leaving the fat in the pan.
Cook the shrimp in the bacon fat over medium-high heat for 1 to 2 minutes per side, until pink. Add the garlic for 30 seconds, then the lemon juice.
Spoon the shrimp over the grits and top with bacon and green onions.

recipes.title: Lemon Herb Baked Salmon
recipes.description: Salmon fillets roasted with lemon, garlic, and dill.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet.
Place the salmon skin-side down. Mix the oil, garlic, and lemon zest, and brush over the fish.
Season with salt and pepper and lay the lemon slices on top.
Roast for 12 to 15 minutes, until the salmon flakes easily.
Sprinkle with dill before serving.

recipes.title: French Toast
recipes.description: Golden custardy toast with cinnamon and vanilla.
steps: Whisk the eggs, milk, vanilla, cinnamon, and sugar in a shallow dish.
Melt a little butter in a skillet over medium heat.
Dip each slice of bread in the egg mixture for a few seconds per side.
Cook until golden, 2 to 3 minutes per side, adding butter as needed.
Serve warm with maple syrup.

recipes.title: Maple Nut Granola
recipes.description: Crunchy clusters of oats and nuts, sweetened with maple syrup.
steps: Heat the oven to 325°F (160°C) and line a baking sheet.
Mix the oats, almonds, pumpkin seeds, salt, and cinnamon.
Stir in the maple syrup and coconut oil until everything is coated.
Spread out evenly and press down firmly. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, turning the pan halfway, until golden.
Cool completely without stirring so it forms clusters, then break up and add the cranberries.

recipes.title: Lemon Bars
recipes.description: A buttery shortbread base under a bright lemon layer.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and line an 8-inch square pan with parchment.
Mix 1 cup flour, the powdered sugar, and the butter into a crumbly dough. Press into the pan and bake for 18 to 20 minutes until pale golden.
Whisk the sugar, 2 tablespoons flour, eggs, lemon juice, and zest until smooth.
Pour over the warm crust and bake for 20 to 25 minutes more, until the filling barely jiggles.
Cool, then chill for 2 hours before cutting. Dust with more powdered sugar if you like.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cookies
recipes.description: Chewy cookies with the classic crisscross fork marks.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C).
Beat the butter, peanut butter, sugar, and brown sugar until fluffy. Beat in the egg and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking soda, and salt.
Roll into 1-inch balls, place on baking sheets, and press each one with a fork in a crisscross.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the edges are set. Cool on the sheet for 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Turkey Club Sandwich
recipes.description: A stacked sandwich of turkey, bacon, lettuce, and tomato.
steps: Spread mayonnaise on one side of each slice of toast.
On two slices, layer turkey and lettuce, then top each with another slice of toast.
Add the bacon and tomato, then the last slices of toast, mayonnaise side down.
Hold together with toothpicks and cut into triangles.

recipes.title: Penne all’Arrabbiata
recipes.description: Penne in a garlicky tomato sauce with a kick of chili.
steps: Cook the penne in well-salted boiling water until al dente. Save 1/2 cup of the pasta water, then drain.
Meanwhile, warm the oil in a large skillet over medium-low heat. Cook the garlic and pepper flakes until fragrant, about 1 minute, without browning.
Add the tomatoes and a pinch of salt and simmer for 15 minutes.
Toss the pasta with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed. Top with parsley.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Carbonara
recipes.description: Silky egg and cheese sauce with crisp pancetta.
steps: Cook the spaghetti in well-salted boiling water until al dente. Save 1 cup of the pasta water.
Meanwhile, cook the pancetta in a large skillet over medium heat until crisp. Turn off the heat.
Whisk the eggs, Parmesan, and pepper in a bowl.
Add the drained pasta to the skillet and toss in the fat. Let it cool for a minute so the eggs won't scramble.
Pour in the egg mixture and toss quickly, adding splashes of pasta water until the sauce is creamy. Serve at once.

recipes.title: Margherita Pizza
recipes.description: Thin-crust pizza with tomato, mozzarella, and basil.
steps: Put a baking sheet or pizza stone in the oven and heat to the highest setting, about 500°F (260°C), for 30 minutes.
Mix the tomatoes, garlic, and salt.
Stretch the dough into a 12-inch round on a floured sheet of parchment.
Spread on the sauce, leaving a border, and scatter the mozzarella. Drizzle with oil.
Slide the pizza, on its parchment, onto the hot sheet. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the crust is browned and the cheese bubbles.
Top with basil and slice.

recipes.title: Vegetable Minestrone
recipes.description: A hearty Italian vegetable soup with beans and small pasta.
steps: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Cook the onion, carrots, and celery until soft, about 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and zucchini and cook 2 minutes more.
Add the tomatoes and broth, bring to a boil, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the beans and pasta and cook until the pasta is tender, about 10 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted and season with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Chicken Piccata
recipes.description: Pan-fried chicken in a lemon, butter, and caper sauce.
steps: Season the chicken with salt and pepper and dredge in the flour, shaking off the extra.
Heat the oil and 1 tablespoon of the butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken until golden and cooked through, 3 to 4 minutes per side. Set aside.
Add the broth, lemon juice, and capers to the pan, scraping up the browned bits, and simmer for 2 minutes.
Turn off the heat and swirl in the remaining butter.
Return the chicken to the pan, spoon the sauce over it, and top with parsley.

recipes.title: Mushroom Risotto
recipes.description: Creamy risotto stirred with browned mushrooms and Parmesan.
steps: Keep the broth warm in a saucepan over low heat.
Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium-high heat. Brown the mushrooms, about 6 minutes, season, and set aside.
Lower the heat to medium, cook the shallot until soft, then stir in the rice for 1 minute.
Add the wine and stir until absorbed.
Add the broth a ladle at a time, stirring often and letting each addition absorb before the next, for 20 to 25 minutes, until the rice is creamy but still has a little bite.
Stir in the mushrooms, butter, and Parmesan. Season and serve right away.

recipes.title: Caprese Salad
recipes.description: Ripe tomatoes, fresh mozzarella, and basil with olive oil.
steps: Arrange the tomato and mozzarella slices on a platter, overlapping and alternating them.
Tuck basil leaves between the slices.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar, if using.
Season with flaky salt and pepper just before serving.

recipes.title: Easy Tiramisu
recipes.description: Coffee-soaked ladyfingers layered with sweet mascarpone cream.
steps: Whip the cream, powdered sugar, and vanilla to soft peaks.
Stir the mascarpone until smooth, then fold in the whipped cream.
Quickly dip half the ladyfingers in the coffee, one at a time, and lay them in an 8-inch square dish.
Spread half the cream over them. Repeat with the rest of the ladyfingers and cream.
Cover and chill for at least 6 hours. Dust with cocoa before serving.

recipes.title: Tomato Bruschetta
recipes.description: Toasted bread topped with fresh tomatoes, garlic, and basil.

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.note: minced, plus 1 whole clove for rubbing

steps: Mix the tomatoes, minced garlic, basil, and olive oil. Season with salt and pepper and let sit for 10 minutes.
Toast the baguette slices under the broiler or in a pan until golden.
Rub each warm toast with the cut side of the whole garlic clove.
Spoon the tomato mixture on top just before serving, so the bread stays crisp.

recipes.title: Eggplant Parmesan
recipes.description: Baked eggplant layered with marinara and melted cheese.
steps: Sprinkle the eggplant with salt and let it sit for 20 minutes. Pat dry.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Mix the breadcrumbs with half the Parmesan.
Dip each slice in egg, then in the crumbs, and place on oiled baking sheets. Drizzle with oil and bake for 20 minutes, turning once, until golden.
Lower the oven to 375°F (190°C). Layer sauce, eggplant, and mozzarella in a 9 by 13-inch dish, ending with sauce and cheese. Top with the rest of the Parmesan.
Bake for 25 minutes until bubbling. Rest for 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Shrimp Scampi with Linguine
recipes.description: Garlicky shrimp in white wine and butter over linguine.
steps: Cook the linguine in well-salted boiling water until al dente. Save 1/2 cup of the pasta water.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the shrimp for 1 minute per side, until just pink, and set aside.
Lower the heat, add the garlic and pepper flakes, and cook for 30 seconds. Add the wine and simmer until reduced by half.
Stir in the butter and lemon juice, then add the pasta, shrimp, and parsley. Toss, adding pasta water if needed, and season.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchiladas
recipes.description: Tortillas rolled around chicken and cheese, baked in red sauce.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Mix the chicken, half the cheese, the green chiles, cumin, and 1/2 cup of the sauce.
Spread 1/2 cup of sauce in a 9 by 13-inch baking dish.
Fill each warm tortilla with the chicken mixture, roll it up, and place it seam-side down in the dish.
Pour the rest of the sauce over the top and sprinkle with the remaining cheese.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until bubbling. Top with cilantro.

recipes.title: Fresh Guacamole
recipes.description: Chunky avocado dip with lime, onion, and cilantro.
steps: Halve the avocados, remove the pits, and scoop the flesh into a bowl.
Mash with a fork, leaving some chunks.
Stir in the lime juice, onion, jalapeño, cilantro, and salt.
Taste and add more lime or salt. Serve right away, or press plastic wrap onto the surface to keep it green.

recipes.title: Pico de Gallo
recipes.description: A fresh, chunky tomato salsa for chips and tacos.
steps: Combine the tomatoes, onion, jalapeño, and cilantro in a bowl.
Add the lime juice and salt and stir.
Let sit for 15 minutes so the flavors come together. Drain off extra liquid before serving.

recipes.title: Huevos Rancheros
recipes.description: Fried eggs on crisp tortillas with warm salsa and beans.
steps: Warm the refried beans and the salsa in separate small pans.
Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and fry each tortilla until lightly crisp, about 1 minute per side. Drain on paper towels.
In the same pan, fry the eggs to your liking.
Spread beans on each tortilla, top with an egg, and spoon salsa around it.
Finish with queso fresco, avocado, and cilantro.

recipes.title: Pork Carnitas
recipes.description: Tender braised pork, crisped at the end, for tacos.
steps: Toss the pork with the salt, cumin, and oregano and put it in a Dutch oven with the onion and garlic.
Add the orange juice and water. Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook on low for about 2 1/2 hours, until very tender.
Uncover, turn the heat to medium-high, and cook until the liquid evaporates and the pork starts to fry in its own fat.
Shred the pork with two forks and keep cooking, stirring now and then, until crisp in places.
Serve in warm tortillas with your favorite toppings.

recipes.title: Mexican Red Rice
recipes.description: Fluffy tomato rice, toasted before simmering.
steps: Heat the oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the rice and stir until it turns golden, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic and cook for 2 minutes.
Stir in the tomato sauce, broth, salt, and cumin, and bring to a boil.
Cover, turn the heat to low, and cook for 18 to 20 minutes.
Turn off the heat and let it sit, covered, for 5 minutes before fluffing.

recipes.title: Chicken Tortilla Soup
recipes.description: A smoky tomato broth with chicken, topped with crisp tortilla strips.
steps: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Cook the onion until soft, then add the garlic, jalapeño, cumin, and chili powder for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, broth, and chicken. Simmer for 20 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through.
Lift out the chicken, shred it, and return it to the pot with the beans and corn. Simmer 5 minutes more.
Stir in the lime juice and season to taste.
Serve topped with crushed tortilla chips and avocado.

recipes.title: Baja Fish Tacos
recipes.description: Spiced white fish in tortillas with crunchy slaw and lime crema.
steps: Season the fish with the chili powder, cumin, and salt.
Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the fish for 2 to 3 minutes per side, until it flakes easily.
Stir half the lime juice into the sour cream. Toss the cabbage with the remaining lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Fill the tortillas with fish and cabbage, drizzle with the lime crema, and top with cilantro.

recipes.title: Ratatouille
recipes.description: Summer vegetables slowly stewed with herbs and olive oil.
steps: Heat half the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Cook the onion and pepper until soft, about 8 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the rest of the oil and the eggplant and cook for 5 minutes, stirring.
Add the zucchini, tomatoes, and thyme. Season with salt and pepper.
Cover and simmer on low for 30 minutes, stirring now and then, until everything is tender.
Top with torn basil. It's good hot, warm, or cold.

recipes.title: French Onion Soup
recipes.description: Deeply caramelized onions in rich broth under cheesy toast.
steps: Melt the butter in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onions and sugar and cook, stirring often, for 45 to 60 minutes, until deep golden brown.
Add the garlic for 1 minute, then the wine, scraping up the browned bits.
Add the broth and thyme, simmer for 20 minutes, and season.
Ladle into oven-safe bowls, top each with a slice of toast and a handful of Gruyère.
Broil until the cheese bubbles and browns, 2 to 3 minutes.

recipes.title: Quiche Lorraine
recipes.description: A buttery tart with a creamy egg, bacon, and Gruyère filling.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Bake the crust for 10 minutes, then set aside.
Cook the bacon until crisp and drain it.
Scatter the bacon and Gruyère over the crust.
Whisk the eggs, half-and-half, salt, pepper, and nutmeg, and pour into the crust.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until the center is just set. Cool for 15 minutes before slicing.

recipes.title: Simple Crêpes
recipes.description: Thin, tender pancakes for sweet or savory fillings.

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.note: melted, plus more for the pan

steps: Blend or whisk all the ingredients until completely smooth. Rest the batter for 15 minutes.
Heat a lightly buttered nonstick pan over medium heat.
Pour in about 1/4 cup of batter and swirl to coat the bottom thinly.
Cook until the edges lift, about 1 minute, then flip and cook 30 seconds more.
Repeat with the rest of the batter, stacking the crêpes. Fill with fruit, jam, or ham and cheese.

recipes.title: Dijon Chicken Thighs
recipes.description: Crisp-skinned chicken in a creamy mustard pan sauce.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Season the chicken well.
In an oven-safe skillet, cook the chicken skin-side down in the oil over medium-high heat until the skin is deep golden, about 8 minutes. Flip.
Roast in the oven for 20 to 25 minutes, until the chicken reaches 175°F (80°C). Move the chicken to a plate.
Pour off most of the fat, then cook the shallot on the stove for 1 minute. Add the broth and scrape up the browned bits.
Whisk in the mustard, cream, and thyme and simmer until slightly thickened. Spoon over the chicken.

recipes.title: Croque Monsieur
recipes.description: A toasted ham and Gruyère sandwich topped with creamy sauce.
steps: Heat the broiler. Melt the butter in a saucepan, whisk in the flour for 1 minute, then whisk in the milk and simmer until thick. Stir in the nutmeg and 1/2 cup of the cheese.
Spread mustard on four slices of bread. Top with ham and half the remaining cheese, then the other slices of bread.
Toast the sandwiches in a skillet until golden on both sides.
Spread the sauce over the tops, sprinkle with the rest of the cheese, and broil until bubbling and browned.

recipes.title: Spanish Tortilla
recipes.description: A thick potato and onion omelet, good warm or cold.
steps: Heat the oil in a 10-inch nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add the potatoes, onion, and half the salt, and cook gently, turning now and then, until tender but not browned, about 20 minutes.
Drain the potatoes and onion, saving the oil.
Beat the eggs with the rest of the salt and stir in the potatoes. Let sit for 5 minutes.
Heat 2 tablespoons of the saved oil in the skillet. Pour in the mixture and cook on medium-low until the edges set, about 6 minutes.
Put a large plate over the pan, flip the tortilla onto it, and slide it back in to cook the other side for 3 to 4 minutes.

recipes.title: Chilled Gazpacho
recipes.description: A refreshing blended soup of raw tomatoes and vegetables.
steps: Blend the tomatoes, cucumber, bell pepper, garlic, vinegar, and salt until very smooth.
With the blender running, slowly pour in the olive oil.
Taste and adjust the salt and vinegar.
Chill for at least 2 hours. Serve cold, with a drizzle of oil and diced cucumber on top.

recipes.title: Garlic Shrimp
recipes.description: Shrimp sizzled in olive oil with lots of garlic and chili.
steps: Warm the oil, garlic, and pepper flakes in a skillet over medium-low heat until the garlic is fragrant and just golden, about 3 minutes.
Turn the heat to medium-high, add the shrimp, and cook for 1 to 2 minutes per side, until pink.
Sprinkle with paprika and salt and toss.
Top with parsley and serve sizzling, with bread for the oil.

recipes.title: Seafood Paella
recipes.description: Saffron rice with shrimp and mussels, cooked in one wide pan.
steps: Heat the oil in a 12-inch paella pan or wide skillet over medium heat. Cook the onion and pepper until soft, then add the garlic and paprika for 1 minute.
Crumble in the saffron, add the rice, and stir to coat. Add the tomatoes and broth, season with salt, and bring to a boil.
Spread the rice evenly and simmer without stirring for 15 minutes.
Nestle in the shrimp and mussels, scatter the peas, and cook 8 to 10 minutes more, until the mussels open and the rice is tender. Throw away any mussels that stay closed.
Turn up the heat for the last minute to form a crust on the bottom. Rest 5 minutes and serve with lemon.

recipes.title: Kung Pao Chicken
recipes.description: Stir-fried chicken with peanuts, chiles, and a glossy sauce.
steps: Toss the chicken with the cornstarch and 1 tablespoon of the soy sauce.
Stir the rest of the soy sauce with the vinegar and sugar.
Heat the oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat. Add the chiles for 20 seconds, then the chicken, and stir-fry until cooked through, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds, then the sauce, and toss until glossy.
Stir in the peanuts and green onions and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Beef and Broccoli
recipes.description: Tender beef and crisp broccoli in a savory brown sauce.
steps: Toss the beef with the cornstarch.
Steam or boil the broccoli for 2 minutes, until bright green, and drain.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat. Sear the beef in a single layer for 1 to 2 minutes per side and set aside.
Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds, then the soy sauce, oyster sauce, brown sugar, and water. Simmer until slightly thick.
Return the beef and broccoli and toss to coat. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Mapo Tofu
recipes.description: Silky tofu and ground pork in a spicy, tingly bean sauce.
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Brown the pork, breaking it up.
Add the bean paste, garlic, and ginger and stir-fry for 1 minute until the oil turns red.
Add the broth and soy sauce, then gently slide in the tofu. Simmer for 5 minutes without stirring hard.
Stir in the cornstarch mixture and cook until the sauce thickens.
Sprinkle with the ground peppercorns and green onions. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Egg Drop Soup
recipes.description: Light broth with silky ribbons of egg, ready in 15 minutes.
steps: Bring the broth, soy sauce, and ginger to a simmer.
Stir in the cornstarch mixture and simmer until slightly thick, about 1 minute.
Stir the soup in a slow circle and pour in the eggs in a thin stream, so they form ribbons.
Turn off the heat, add the sesame oil and white pepper, and top with green onions.

recipes.title: Vegetable Lo Mein
recipes.description: Soft noodles tossed with crisp vegetables in a savory sauce.
steps: Cook the noodles according to the package, drain, and rinse briefly.
Stir the soy sauce, hoisin, sugar, and sesame oil together.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wok over high heat. Stir-fry the garlic for 30 seconds, then the pepper, carrot, cabbage, and snow peas for 3 minutes.
Add the noodles, sauce, and green onions and toss until hot and coated.

recipes.title: Scallion Pancakes
recipes.description: Crisp, flaky flatbreads layered with green onion.
steps: Stir the hot water into the flour until a shaggy dough forms. Knead for 5 minutes until smooth, then cover and rest for 20 minutes.
Divide into 4 pieces. Roll one out thin, brush with sesame oil, and sprinkle with salt and green onions.
Roll it up like a rope, coil it into a spiral, and roll the spiral flat again to about 7 inches. Repeat with the rest.
Fry each pancake in a little oil over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side, until golden and crisp.
Cut into wedges and serve with soy sauce for dipping.

recipes.title: Butter Chicken
recipes.description: Tender chicken in a mild, creamy tomato sauce.
steps: Mix the chicken with the yogurt, 1 teaspoon of the garam masala, and the salt. Let it sit for at least 15 minutes.
Melt 1 tablespoon of the butter in a large pan over medium-high heat and brown the chicken in batches. Set aside.
Melt the rest of the butter, cook the onion until soft, then add the garlic, ginger, cumin, chili powder, and the rest of the garam masala for 1 minute.
Add the tomato sauce and simmer for 10 minutes. Stir in the cream and the chicken and simmer for 10 minutes more.
Top with cilantro and serve with rice or naan.

recipes.title: Dal Tadka
recipes.description: Yellow lentils finished with sizzling spiced oil.
steps: Simmer the lentils, water, turmeric, and salt for 25 to 30 minutes, until very soft. Whisk until creamy.
Heat the oil in a small pan over medium heat. Add the cumin seeds until they sizzle.
Add the onion and cook until golden, then the garlic, tomato, and chili powder until the tomato softens.
Pour this spiced oil into the lentils and stir. Add the lemon juice and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Palak Paneer
recipes.description: Golden paneer cubes in a smooth, spiced spinach sauce.
steps: Blanch the spinach in boiling water for 1 minute, rinse under cold water, squeeze dry, and blend until smooth.
Heat the oil in a pan and brown the paneer on all sides. Set aside.
Cook the onion until soft, then add the garlic, ginger, chile, cumin, and garam masala for 1 minute.
Stir in the spinach and salt and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the cream and paneer and warm through. Serve with naan or rice.

recipes.title: Aloo Gobi
recipes.description: Potatoes and cauliflower cooked with turmeric and cumin.
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the cumin seeds until they sizzle, then the onion until soft.
Stir in the garlic, ginger, turmeric, coriander, and chili powder for 1 minute.
Add the potatoes, cauliflower, and salt and toss to coat.
Add the water, cover, and cook on low for 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until the vegetables are tender.
Uncover for the last few minutes to brown them a little. Top with cilantro.

recipes.title: Vegetable Biryani
recipes.description: Fragrant spiced rice baked with vegetables.
steps: Heat the oil in a heavy pot over medium heat and cook the onion until deep golden, about 10 minutes. Set half aside for topping.
Add the garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the vegetables, yogurt, garam masala, turmeric, and salt. Cook for 5 minutes.
Drain the rice, add it to the pot with the water, and bring to a boil.
Cover tightly, turn the heat to the lowest setting, and cook for 20 minutes.
Rest for 10 minutes, then fluff gently and top with the saved onions and mint.

recipes.title: Mango Lassi
recipes.description: A cool, creamy mango and yogurt drink.
steps: Blend everything until completely smooth.
Taste and add more sugar if your mango isn't very sweet.
Pour over ice and serve cold.

recipes.title: Cucumber Raita
recipes.description: A cooling yogurt sauce for spicy dishes.
steps: Stir the yogurt until smooth.
Mix in the cucumber, cumin, mint, and salt.
Chill until serving. Serve alongside curries or biryani.

recipes.title: Chicken Teriyaki
recipes.description: Juicy chicken in a sweet, glossy soy glaze.
steps: Pat the chicken dry. Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook the chicken skin-side down until crisp, about 7 minutes. Flip and cook 5 minutes more.
Wipe out most of the fat. Stir the soy sauce, mirin, sake, and sugar together and pour into the pan.
Simmer, turning the chicken often, until the sauce is thick and glossy, 3 to 4 minutes.
Slice, spoon over the sauce, and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Miso Soup
recipes.description: A simple, savory soup with tofu, seaweed, and green onion.
steps: Soak the kombu in the water for 10 minutes, then heat until just before boiling and lift it out.
Add the wakame and simmer for 2 minutes until it softens.
Turn the heat to low. Whisk the miso with a ladle of the broth, then stir it back in. Don't let it boil.
Add the tofu to warm through and top with green onions.

recipes.title: Oyakodon
recipes.description: Chicken and egg simmered in sweet dashi broth over rice.
steps: Simmer the dashi, soy sauce, mirin, and sugar in a small skillet. Add the onion and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the chicken and simmer until cooked through, about 6 minutes.
Pour the eggs over the top, cover, and cook for 1 to 2 minutes, until just set but still soft.
Slide over bowls of hot rice and top with green onion.

recipes.title: Cucumber Sunomono
recipes.description: A crisp, sweet-and-sour cucumber salad.
steps: Toss the cucumbers with the salt and let them sit for 10 minutes. Squeeze out the liquid.
Stir the vinegar, sugar, and soy sauce until the sugar dissolves.
Toss the cucumbers with the dressing and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Serve chilled.

recipes.title: Yaki Udon
recipes.description: Thick udon noodles stir-fried with vegetables and soy.
steps: Loosen the udon in hot water for 1 minute and drain.
Stir the soy sauce, mirin, and sugar together.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat. Stir-fry the mushrooms, cabbage, and carrot for 3 minutes.
Add the noodles, sauce, and green onions and toss until the noodles are hot and coated.

recipes.title: Shrimp Pad Thai
recipes.description: Rice noodles with shrimp, egg, and peanuts in a tangy sauce.
steps: Soak the noodles in hot water until soft but still firm, about 10 minutes, then drain.
Stir the fish sauce, brown sugar, lime juice, and tamarind together.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat. Cook the garlic and shrimp until the shrimp turn pink. Push to one side.
Scramble the eggs in the empty side of the pan.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss for 2 minutes, until absorbed. Add the bean sprouts and green onions.
Serve topped with peanuts and lime wedges.

recipes.title: Thai Green Curry Chicken
recipes.description: Chicken and vegetables in a fragrant coconut curry.
steps: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat. Fry the curry paste for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in the coconut milk and broth and bring to a simmer.
Add the chicken and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add the pepper and green beans and cook 5 minutes more, until tender-crisp.
Season with the fish sauce and sugar, stir in the basil, and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Tom Kha Gai
recipes.description: Coconut chicken soup with lemongrass, lime, and mushrooms.
steps: Simmer the broth, coconut milk, lemongrass, and ginger for 10 minutes.
Add the chicken and mushrooms and simmer until the chicken is cooked, about 6 minutes.
Turn off the heat and stir in the fish sauce, lime juice, and sugar. Taste and adjust.
Remove the lemongrass pieces and top with cilantro.

recipes.title: Thai Basil Chicken
recipes.description: Spicy minced chicken stir-fried with basil, over rice.
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over high heat. Stir-fry the garlic and chiles for 20 seconds.
Add the chicken and cook, breaking it up, until no longer pink.
Add the oyster sauce, soy sauce, fish sauce, and sugar and toss for 1 minute.
Turn off the heat and stir in the basil until wilted. Serve over rice, with a fried egg if you like.

recipes.title: Mango Sticky Rice
recipes.description: Sweet coconut sticky rice with ripe mango.
steps: Drain the rice and steam it in a cloth-lined steamer for 20 to 25 minutes, until tender and chewy.
Warm 3/4 of the coconut milk with the sugar and salt until dissolved. Pour over the hot rice, stir, and cover for 15 minutes to absorb.
Warm the remaining coconut milk with a pinch of salt to make a topping.
Serve the rice with mango slices, drizzled with the topping and sprinkled with sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Beef Bulgogi
recipes.description: Thin slices of beef in a sweet soy and pear marinade.
steps: Mix the soy sauce, brown sugar, pear, garlic, sesame oil, and ginger. Toss with the beef and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over high heat.
Cook the beef in batches in a single layer, 1 to 2 minutes per side, until caramelized.
Top with green onions and sesame seeds. Serve with rice and lettuce leaves for wrapping.

recipes.title: Bibimbap
recipes.description: A rice bowl with seasoned vegetables, beef, and a fried egg.
steps: Cook the beef with 1 tablespoon of the soy sauce and the sugar until browned.
Cook each vegetable separately with a little sesame oil and soy sauce, just until tender, and season with salt.
Fry the eggs, keeping the yolks runny.
Divide the rice among bowls, arrange the vegetables and beef on top in sections, and add an egg.
Serve with gochujang to mix in to taste.

recipes.title: Kimchi Fried Rice
recipes.description: Spicy, tangy fried rice using leftover rice and kimchi.

ingredients.name: kimchi
ingredients.note: chopped, with 2 tbsp of its juice

steps: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Stir-fry the kimchi for 3 minutes.
Add the rice, kimchi juice, gochujang, and soy sauce and stir-fry until hot and evenly red.
Stir in the sesame oil and divide between plates.
Fry the eggs and place one on each plate. Top with green onion.

recipes.title: Spicy Korean Cucumber Salad
recipes.description: Crunchy cucumbers tossed with chili, garlic, and sesame.
steps: Toss the cucumbers with the salt and let them sit for 10 minutes. Drain off the liquid.
Mix the garlic, chili flakes, vinegar, sugar, and sesame oil.
Toss the cucumbers in the dressing and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Serve right away.

recipes.title: Chicken Pho
recipes.description: Aromatic chicken noodle soup with star anise and fresh herbs.

ingredients.name: fresh Thai basil, cilantro, and lime wedges

steps: Char the onion and ginger, cut-side down, in a dry pot over high heat until blackened in spots, about 5 minutes.
Add the broth, star anise, and cinnamon and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the chicken and simmer until cooked through, about 15 minutes. Lift out and slice thinly.
Strain the broth and season with the fish sauce and sugar.
Cook the noodles according to the package and divide among bowls. Add the chicken, ladle over the hot broth, and serve with sprouts, herbs, and lime.

recipes.title: Fresh Tofu Spring Rolls
recipes.description: Rice paper rolls with tofu, herbs, and a peanut dip.
steps: Whisk the peanut butter, hoisin, lime juice, and warm water into a smooth dip.
Dip a rice paper wrapper in warm water for a few seconds until just soft and lay it flat.
Add a little vermicelli, tofu, carrot, cucumber, and herbs near the bottom edge.
Fold in the sides and roll up tightly. Repeat with the rest.
Serve right away with the peanut dip.

recipes.title: Lemongrass Chicken
recipes.description: Caramelized chicken with lemongrass and garlic.
steps: Mix the lemongrass, garlic, fish sauce, and brown sugar. Toss with the chicken and marinate for at least 20 minutes.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the shallot for 1 minute.
Add the chicken in a single layer and cook without moving for 3 minutes, then stir and cook until caramelized and cooked through, about 8 minutes more.
Top with the chile and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Chicken Souvlaki
recipes.description: Lemon-oregano chicken skewers, grilled or broiled.
steps: Mix the oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper. Toss with the chicken and marinate for 30 minutes to 4 hours in the fridge.
If you're using wooden skewers, soak them in water for 20 minutes.
Thread the chicken onto skewers.
Grill or broil on high heat for 10 to 12 minutes, turning a few times, until charred in spots and cooked through.
Serve with warm pita and tzatziki.

recipes.title: Tzatziki
recipes.description: A garlicky yogurt and cucumber dip.
steps: Squeeze the grated cucumber in a clean towel to remove as much water as you can.
Stir together the yogurt, garlic, lemon juice, oil, dill, and salt.
Mix in the cucumber.
Chill for 30 minutes before serving with pita, vegetables, or grilled meat.

recipes.title: Spinach and Feta Triangles
recipes.description: Crisp phyllo pastries filled with spinach and feta.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C) and line two baking sheets.
Mix the spinach, feta, green onions, dill, egg, and nutmeg.
Lay one sheet of phyllo flat, brush with butter, top with a second sheet, and brush again. Cut into 3 long strips. Keep the rest of the phyllo covered with a damp towel.
Put a spoonful of filling at the end of each strip and fold it up like a flag into a triangle. Brush the tops with butter.
Repeat with the rest of the phyllo and filling. Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until golden.

recipes.title: Avgolemono Soup
recipes.description: A silky Greek chicken and rice soup with egg and lemon.
steps: Bring the broth to a boil, add the rice, and simmer until tender, about 18 minutes. Add the chicken.
Whisk the eggs and lemon juice in a bowl until frothy.
Slowly whisk 2 cups of the hot broth into the eggs, a little at a time, so they warm without scrambling.
Stir the egg mixture back into the pot over low heat until the soup thickens slightly. Do not let it boil.
Season with salt and pepper and top with dill.

recipes.title: Classic Hummus
recipes.description: Smooth chickpea dip with tahini, lemon, and garlic.
steps: Blend the tahini and lemon juice for 1 minute until light and creamy.
Add the chickpeas, garlic, salt, and cumin and blend until thick.
With the blender running, add the cold water a tablespoon at a time until very smooth.
Spread in a bowl, drizzle with olive oil, and sprinkle with paprika.

recipes.title: Shakshuka
recipes.description: Eggs gently poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce.
steps: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the onion and pepper until soft, about 8 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin, paprika, and pepper flakes for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, season, and simmer for 10 minutes until thickened.
Make six wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each. Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 minutes, until the whites are set.
Top with feta and parsley. Serve with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Baked Falafel
recipes.description: Herby chickpea patties baked until crisp, not fried.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and brush a baking sheet with 1 tablespoon of the oil.
Pulse the chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, cilantro, cumin, coriander, and salt in a food processor until finely chopped but not smooth.
Stir in the flour. Shape into about 16 small patties.
Place on the sheet and brush the tops with the rest of the oil.
Bake for 25 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and crisp. Serve in pita with hummus or tahini.

recipes.title: Tabbouleh
recipes.description: A bright parsley and bulgur salad with lemon and mint.
steps: Pour the boiling water over the bulgur, cover, and let it soak for 15 minutes. Fluff with a fork and cool.
Combine the parsley, mint, tomatoes, and green onions in a large bowl.
Whisk the lemon juice, olive oil, and salt.
Add the bulgur and dressing to the vegetables and toss. Taste and add more lemon or salt.

recipes.title: Red Lentil Soup
recipes.description: A golden, lemony lentil soup that comes together quickly.
steps: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Cook the onion and carrot until soft, about 6 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin, and turmeric for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, broth, and salt. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 20 minutes until the lentils fall apart.
Blend until smooth, or leave it chunky. Stir in the lemon juice and serve.

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Chicken Shawarma
recipes.description: Warmly spiced chicken and onions roasted on one pan.

ingredients.name: pita bread, tomatoes, and garlic yogurt sauce

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Mix the oil, lemon juice, garlic, and spices. Toss with the chicken and onion.
Spread on a large baking sheet in a single layer.
Roast for 25 to 30 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through and browned at the edges.
Slice the chicken and serve in pita with tomatoes and garlic yogurt sauce.

recipes.title: Shepherd’s Pie
recipes.description: Savory ground lamb and vegetables under fluffy mashed potatoes.
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain and mash with the butter and milk. Season.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Heat the oil in a large skillet and brown the lamb. Pour off most of the fat. Add the onion and carrots and cook until soft.
Stir in the tomato paste and flour for 1 minute, then the broth and thyme. Simmer until thick, about 5 minutes. Stir in the peas and season.
Spread the filling in a baking dish and cover with the mashed potatoes, roughing up the top with a fork.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until the top is golden.

recipes.title: Cream Scones
recipes.description: Tender, lightly sweet scones for jam and cream.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C) and line a baking sheet.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt. Rub in the butter until it looks like coarse crumbs.
Stir in the cream just until a soft dough forms.
Pat the dough into a 7-inch round about 1 inch thick and cut into 8 wedges.
Place on the sheet, brush the tops with cream, and bake for 13 to 15 minutes, until golden.

recipes.title: Jerk Chicken
recipes.description: Chicken in a spicy allspice and thyme marinade, roasted until charred.
steps: Blend everything except the chicken into a paste. Wear gloves when handling the pepper.
Rub the paste all over the chicken and marinate in the fridge for at least 2 hours, or overnight.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C), or heat a grill to medium.
Roast or grill the chicken for 35 to 40 minutes, turning on the grill, until charred and cooked through to 175°F (80°C).
Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Rice and Peas
recipes.description: Coconut rice cooked with kidney beans, thyme, and allspice.
steps: Bring the beans and their liquid, coconut milk, water, green onions, garlic, thyme, allspice, and salt to a boil in a heavy pot.
Stir in the rice and return to a boil.
Cover, turn the heat to low, and cook for 20 to 25 minutes, until the liquid is absorbed.
Remove the thyme stems and fluff before serving.

recipes.title: Chickpea and Vegetable Tagine
recipes.description: A gently spiced stew of chickpeas, squash, and apricots.
steps: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat and cook the onion until soft. Add the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the squash, carrots, chickpeas, tomatoes, broth, and apricots, and season with salt.
Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer for 30 minutes, until the squash is tender.
Top with cilantro and serve with couscous.

recipes.title: Moroccan Carrot Salad
recipes.description: Tender carrots tossed with cumin, lemon, and herbs.
steps: Boil the carrots in salted water until just tender, 6 to 8 minutes. Drain.
Whisk the oil, lemon juice, garlic, cumin, paprika, and salt.
Toss the warm carrots in the dressing and let them sit for 15 minutes.
Stir in the parsley. Serve warm or at room temperature.
